events.title: Go 1.18 added generics
events.summary: Go 1.18 released on March 15, 2022 with type parameters — the language's most requested feature after a decade of interfaces-only abstraction.
events.about: Generics let Go developers write `func Map[T any](s []T, f func(T) T)` without code generation hacks. Kubernetes controllers, observability tools, and cloud SDKs adopted generic containers and result types while keeping Go's simple syntax.

narrative.whyChosen: Generics closed the biggest gap between Go and other statically typed languages.
narrative.whyImportant: Libraries could share algorithms without `interface{}` casts or external code generators.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams duplicated slice/map helpers or used unsafe reflection because Go lacked parametric polymorphism.
